description: Vasiljevic, Nikola and colleagues publish this resource through Zenodo. The implemented Python package propagates wind-lidar measurement uncertainty through Monte Carlo calculations. It supports assessment of reconstructed winds and measurement configurations used in wind-energy research. Native metadata identifies a repository whose current canonical owner is nikokaoja; GitHub metadata supplies MIT terms. The presentation deposit has separate non-commercial terms, which do not replace the code licence. The named tool is independently described within the eWindLidar overview, so that overview is retained as supporting context. Coverage is limited to the stated models, observations and application settings. Native metadata gives open access and the licence label cc-nc. These terms describe the deposit; software and companion-data terms are distinguished where separately established. Only descriptive metadata and file descriptors were inspected; linked data, code and document bodies were not opened.
